description: Which crypto sectors money is moving into or out of: CoinGecko's coin categories (AI, memes, DeFi, RWA, L2s, chain ecosystems…) ranked by 24h market-cap change or 24h volume, each with market cap, volume, volume/market cap and its three largest coins with their price and 24h change, plus the weakest categories and how many are up or down. Small categories are filtered out by a minimum market cap. Fails (and is not charged) if CoinGecko doesn't answer. Costs $0.002 USDC per call.

kind.description: all, sectors only (no chain ecosystems or VC portfolios), or chain ecosystems only (default all)

minMarketCapUsd.description: Leave out categories below this market cap in USD (default 50000000)

sortBy.description: Rank by 24h market-cap change % or 24h volume (default market_cap_change)
